column1: # Stretches of T2T-HG002 Q100 v1.1 for locus_depth.py, copied from unconfirmed_placements.tsv: for each locus the
# placements of one of its calls (the first stretch is that call's best placement), and four stretches of ordinary
# sequence (no segmental duplication, satellite or known issue) from which the depth of one copy is taken.
#   chr1_start      locus L02: the two calls the truth genome's own run makes (run35/issues.tsv), and 20 kb on either side
#   chr13_7.26Mb    locus L01: every placement of call u33 that holds a tenth of its k-mers
#   chr13_10.04Mb   locus L17: every placement of call u44 that holds a tenth of its k-mers
#   chr7_58.7Mb     locus L03: the principal placements of call u09
#   chr9_42.4Mb     locus L13: the principal placements of call u31 (u38 is the same sequence)
#   chr22_3.9Mb     locus L14: every placement of call u32 that holds four tenths of its k-mers
